description: Dependency updates as pull requests (replaces WordPress auto-updates). Minor and patch updates merge automatically once every check passes (approved by Arye 2026-10-08); major versions wait for review.

packageRules.description: Astro and its integrations move together
Linting, formatting and test tools in one weekly pull request
TypeScript stays on 6.x until astro check supports 7 (docs/ROADMAP.md)
Wrangler moves in one pull request, in package.json and where a workflow runs it by version (previews.yml), so they stay the same

Minor, patch and lockfile updates merge on their own (Monday mornings) once every check passes (tests, build, Lighthouse, the Keystatic patch); majors, and any update of a 0.x package (where minor versions may break), wait for review.

customManagers.description: Tools pinned inside workflow commands (npx --yes <package>@<version>), which Renovate's GitHub Actions manager doesn't read
gitleaks in the secret scan (its checksum beside it must be updated by hand: the check fails until then)
